rules.source_evidence: bitcell_base_array.route_supplies; reference GDS bitcell/dummy rail propagation
rules.rule_description: Array-internal VDD/GND should propagate from the bitcell and dummy/replica children, preserving their orientation and edge reach.
rules.required_geometry: Array-local supply pins or continuous rails.
rules.required_metadata: rail layer, side/orientation, cell parity effects.

rules.rule_description: Row decoder and wordline drivers need explicit row-periphery rails aligned for later top-level stitch.
rules.required_geometry: Vertical/horizontal row-periphery rails with true pins.

rules.rule_description: Precharge, mux, sense, and write stages require stage-local rails before top-level straps are added.
rules.required_geometry: Per-stage VDD/GND rails and tap points.

rules.rule_description: Control region needs its own stitchable rails or ring targets before top-level strap export.
rules.required_geometry: Control VDD/GND rails and side/ring targets.
rules.required_metadata: power pin type and stitch policy.

rules.rule_description: Top-level VDD/GND straps or rings should be created after sink rails are known and must connect through explicit taps/vias.
rules.required_geometry: Top straps, corner vias, module-rail taps.
rules.required_metadata: strap layer stack, side or ring selection.

rules.rule_description: Top-level VDD/GND pins must coincide with real strap/ring geometry and not be isolated placeholders.
rules.required_geometry: Exported top VDD/GND pin rectangles on final strap/ring layers.
